# Fictional Personas

All personas in this document are invented for the fixture.

## Mara, Training Coordinator

Mara maintains sessions for several topics and locations. She needs efficient
bulk review of place requests and clear capacity information. She prepares an
attendance list before each session.

## Ivo, Staff Member

Ivo searches for learning that fits work commitments. He needs to understand
delivery mode, location, prerequisites, and whether manager approval is
required. He wants to track a request without contacting a coordinator.

## Sela, Department Manager

Sela reviews requests for a distributed team. She needs a concise reason,
session timing, and current workload impact before making a decision.

## Ren, Support Analyst

Ren handles access and notification incidents. Ren needs diagnostic
information and an audit trail but must not see private development notes that
are unrelated to support.
